title: Quenched Velvety Russian Curd Pudding
description: A tangy and velvety Russian dessert featuring a sugar syrup and shio-cure, perfect for crowds, this pudding is a delightful treat that is onion and garlic free.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
In a blender, combine the farmers cheese, granulated sugar, eggs, vanilla extract, and shio cure, then blend until smooth.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the heavy cream and melted butter.
Add the cream mixture to the cheese mixture and blend until well combined.
Pour the mixture into 6 small pudding molds or ramekins.
Place the molds in a large baking dish and add the water to come halfway up the sides of the molds.
Bake for 25 minutes or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove the puddings from the water bath and let them cool to room temperature.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Serve the puddings chilled, with a drizzle of sugar syrup if desired.
